featured_reviews.name: Shirin Rajwade
featured_reviews.review_text: Our experience with Wonderland was wonderful. As a lockdown child, our daughter was having separation  anxiety in the mornings, but the teachers and didis were very patient with her, and found ways to calm her down. Within 10 minutes she would relax and start taking part in all activities. They would send me videos to reassure me of the same. She also spoke voluntarily about all aspects of her day at home, so we got a very thorough understanding of how the children are handled, instructed, and what they learn.  The facility is run by an all female staff and many of the Eurokids children attend Wonderland as both places are managed by Anuja ma'am. The teachers and Didis at the childcare (Wonderland) and the school (Eurokids kandivali) alike, are extremely thorough with keeping the children neat and tidy throughout the day. They also ensure the children are safely transported to and from school and inform parents of the same. They ensure that the children eat their food and assist the ones who need help. In addition to the lunch box sent from home, there is also the option of a hot meal which includes 2 sabzis, roti, daal, and rice. Our child often commented that she liked the schools sabzis better 😂 It was good to know that she was getting that 1 solid meal at day care to get her through her day. The daycare does many different activities on rotation throughout the week, and sends short videos and photos of the child every day. We found that our child's English and Hindi both improved drastically since we mostly speak our mother-tongue at home. Now she is confident in all 3 languages. Anuja ma'am who runs the school is extremely thorough and knows the names and quirks of every student. It is really remarkable that she is able to be that present and knowledgeable about every child. She really helped us settle our daughter and the entire staff were very patient with her, even though the drop off crying continued for close to a year. But our daughter always came home beaming and eager to share, so we were assured that this was her own issue and that the school and staff were doing everything to help her adjust and feel safe. We were very happy with our daughters experience and are unfortunately leaving due to relocation. A huge thank you to Anuja ma'am, all the class teachers, and all the Didis. All the best! Annual day, Navratri, Dassura, Diwali.. and many more festivals were planned with great efforts. Overall experience was remarkable and memorable journey..☺️

featured_reviews.name: Monika Chaturvedi
featured_reviews.review_text: This school provided a warm, nurturing environment where children feel safe and happy. The teachers are caring, patient, and attentive to each child’s needs. Activities are well-planned and encourage creativity, social interaction, and early learning. I’ve seen great improvement in my child’s confidence and communication skills. The all activities were well-organised and so so wonderful that we just mesmerised our children to grow up under such guidance.

featured_reviews.name: shikha rathore
featured_reviews.review_text: The annual function was outstanding. From anchoring to performances, everything was well coordinated. The cultural programs were entertaining and meaningful. Hats off to the teachers, students, and staff for making the event successful.

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav Gehlot
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thank you so much to the Kindergarten Kandivali East branch. This was the first annual day for your branch and also the first for us as parents, making it truly special.
The entire program was a wonderful and unexpected surprise. Not only my child, but every single child performed outstandingly. It was heart-warming to see the confidence and joy in all the children.
A big thank you to all the teachers, support staff, and everyone involved behind the scenes (apologies if I’ve missed anyone). Your hard work truly reflected in the event.
It was an outstanding program and deserving of a standing ovation. Please continue this beautiful tradition every year.

featured_reviews.name: Jitendar Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: We truly appreciate the dedication and efforts of the Kindergarten preschool team. The structured curriculum, combined with engaging activities, has helped our child develop holistically. The teachers ensure personal attention and encourage curiosity, creativity, and independence. It’s reassuring to see our child excited about going to school every day. We are satisfied with the overall development and care provided.

featured_reviews.name: Mahima Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Top-notch preschool! The attentive staff, well-rounded activities, and commitment to child development make Kindergarten day care and activity centre stand out. Our family is grateful for the positive impact it has had on our child's early years.
